'''Tre Timbal''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Timbal, [[Kirbi]], [[Luquena]], and another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to investigate a [[rakghoul]] warren on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], but they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[nekghoul]]s.
